messages:
Olivia (CEO): Thanks for the great Q&A earlier. Wanted a quick follow-up thread on the customer wins/losses we discussed — can folks share the top root causes and the highest-priority asks we should route to product/eng/sales.
Sam (Account Exec): Quick wins: predictable p99 latency + clear cost per 1M tokens helped close a mid-market search infra deal. They loved the dedicated pool pricing. :tada:
Sam (Account Exec): Losses: two logos said no because we didn't have a VPC option and they needed SAML + HSM integration on day 1.
Jenna (CS Lead): From onboarding: customers that churned early cited "integration friction" — mainly SSO + sample app for embeddings retrieval. They want a one-click quickstart for VPC.
Anya (Product PM): Top asks I recorded: 1) VPC/private plane ETA 2) SAML + KMS/HSM docs + examples 3) Longer context support (50k tokens ask) 4) Embedding semantic tuning controls.
Raj (Sales Ops): Also hearing price sensitivity on high-throughput ranking use-cases. Some teams want burstable reserved capacity but cheaper floor pricing for steady load.
Mike (Eng Lead): Technical reality check: VPC/private control plane + HSM is doable but needs infra work. Rough estimate: 3 sprints for MVP (auth + vault integration), 2 more for automated quickstart infra templates.
Liam (Data): From signal: rerank customers that left had 7% lower MAP after migration. Need better embedding versioning + a guide for quantization vs quality tradeoffs.
Olivia (CEO): Helpful. Who owns the action items and can we get a 2-week plan? Small teams only — we need something ship-ready for trials.
Anya (Product PM): I can own scoping. Proposal: ship SAML + KMS docs + a VPC "trial" path (manual provision) in 2 weeks; commit to infra sprints for automated VPC in Q2.
Mike (Eng Lead): Agree. We'll prioritize SAML + KMS integration first. Put a label "all-hands-priority" on tickets.
Sam (Account Exec): I'll compile the top 10 customer asks and sample language for trials. Will also tag 3 at-risk deals we should escalate.
Jenna (CS Lead): I'll draft a VPC quickstart playbook and a demo script for solutions engineers.
Raj (Sales Ops): Can we add a pricing experiment: lower committed baseline for ranking-heavy workloads? I can A/B the offer to two prospects.
Olivia (CEO): Good. Two asks from me: 1) an internal one-pager that summarizes "why we win" and "why we lose" for field teams; 2) a public-facing docs checklist for enterprise evals (security, SLAs, integration).
Liam (Data): I'll pull the metric snippets for the one-pager (p99, MAP drop, token costs) and put them in Confluence by EOD.
Anya (Product PM): I'll draft both the internal one-pager and the external checklist and circulate for review by Friday.
Mike (Eng Lead): Dev note: adding a tag here — any requests that require model changes (longer context, quantization-fidelity) need separate product/ML sync.
Sam (Account Exec): cc @Olivia — also flagged a competitive note: a vendor offered turnkey quantized models. We should clarify our quantization guidance in sales collateral.
Olivia (CEO): Great. If we can get those 2-week artifacts (SAML/KMS docs, top-10 asks, one-pager) that will help reduce churn in trials.
allhands-bot: Reminder: follow-ups from all-hands are tracked at /projects/allhands-customer-followups. Add ticket IDs there with the "all-hands-priority" label.
Jenna (CS Lead): Action items recap: Sam -> top-10 asks + at-risk deals; Anya -> one-pager + checklist + scope; Mike -> SAML/KMS MVP tickets + infra estimate; Liam -> metrics snippets; Raj -> pricing experiment plan. I'll assemble the playbook.
Olivia (CEO): Thanks everyone — please update the project board before EOD tomorrow. Small bites, high impact. :raised_hands:
